frontmatter_description_draft: Produce a 15-second motion-graphics video ad for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Reels or Meta as a rendered H.264 MP4. Researches the destination landing page so every on-screen claim matches it, pulls real product imagery off the live site, fills one CONFIG object in a finished 4:5 GSAP template, and renders the paused timeline frame-accurately through Playwright and ffmpeg. Use when the user wants a video ad, promo video, animated ad, motion graphics, an ad for my product, Meta or TikTok or Reels creative in video form, a 9:16 stories or reels cut, a 1:1 square cut, a 2x master, or a re-render of an earlier ad with a different hook, hero, proof row or CTA, even if they never say motion graphics. Not for animating UI inside an app, static image ads, long-form video, or voiceover-led video.

# Motion Ad — Produce a sound-off 15s ad as one HTML page driven by a paused GSAP timeline; Render each frame by seeking the timeline, never by recording playback (deterministic re-renders); Use assets/template.html as a finished 15s 4:5 ad (hook + phone, before/after scan reveal, 3D wall, showcase carousel + proof, brand-color CTA end card); Start from its CONFIG object and rewrite the beats, never build a timeline from zero; Read references/template-map.md before the first edit of index.html.

## Preflight — Set S to the directory holding this SKILL.md (parent of assets/ and scripts/); default Claude Code install is ~/.claude/skills/motion-ad; find block (verbatim, SKILL.md lines 53-55); toolchain block (verbatim except S= path, lines 60-66); Verify node -v prints v20 or higher (playwright-core 1.63 engines); Done when node, ffmpeg, Pillow and google-chrome (or chromium fallback) each print a version; Stop and report if ffmpeg is missing.

## Non-negotiables — 1 Every on-screen claim (prices, counts, speeds, guarantees, free claims) must exist on the destination page; Read that page (WebFetch or repo source) before writing any headline; If the user asks for contradicting copy, write it and flag the mismatch once. 2 Use only the user's images or ones fetched with scripts/fetch-images.cjs; Never invent customers, reviews, ratings or results; Set proof: null when no real number exists. 3 Never fabricate a person; crop or mirror real shots and tell the user. 4 Take primary/accent/page colors, font, logo and tone from the product; Use no hype, no exclamation marks, no emoji unless the brand uses them.

### Step 1: Research — establish product, destination URL, audience, format (4:5 feed default, 9:16 stories/reels, 1:1 feed squares); Ask only for what cannot be inferred (destination URL is the one required input); WebFetch destination + homepage/pricing for headline promise, prices, rating/review counts, speed claims, free vs paid; Pull brand colors, font family, logo from site CSS/design system or ask; Done when URL, format and a written claim list each traceable to a specific page exist.

### Step 2: Workdir and assets — Work in a scratch dir, never inside the skill folder; bash block verbatim (lines 125-132) with S= path edit; Read images.jpg to pick assets; Put logo in a/ (light-background version + white version for end card if it exists); Pick the hero before/after pair with the clearest transformation (SaaS: messy input -> finished output screenshots); Prefer portrait ~4:5 images for hero and showcase cards; Supply at least 12 distinct wall images; Ask the user for preferred images and prefer theirs; Done when a/ holds logo(s) + hero pair + wall + 3 showcase images and each CONFIG filename is named.

### Step 3: Storyboard and copy — 4-5 beats in 15s, one short headline each; beat-map table verbatim (lines 149-155, label as nominal windows; exact call sites in template-map Timeline map); Limit headlines to ~20 characters per line at 82px in the 960px box; Use \n to place breaks (extra lines grow downward from a fixed top and collide); Change or cut a beat that does not fit the product; Open a desktop-only tool on the hero card instead of the phone; 1:1: phone is 520x1100 and does not fit, so tell the user and let them choose rescale vs different opening beat (template-map -> Re-lay out for 1:1); Done when every beat has final copy and every claim traces to a Step 1 page.

### Step 4: Fill CONFIG and edit the timeline — 6 rules (brand/logo/logoOnDark/colors + Google Fonts link family AND --font; *word* accent, \n break; image paths relative to index.html e.g. a/web/03.jpg, crop/mirror with PIL; tap lands on screen point after screenScroll; Keep window.seek, window.DURATION, window.ready and ?render guard intact; 9:16 or 1:1: change html,body,#stage size, re-space verticals, render with matching --size per template-map); Done when node $S/scripts/render.cjs --stills 0.3 shows real copy, real images, brand colors; Check no template default remains: Acme, Benefit one/two/three, **4.8** · 1,000 reviews, yourdomain.com, Supporting line for the wall, Real customers, real results, No credit card needed (derived check, see notes).

### Step 5: Stills review — bash block verbatim (lines 191-194); Read stills.jpg; Check for: leftover placeholders (wrong path fails silently), text overlapping end-card orbs, empty gaps, labels contradicting their image, same image side by side in the wall, legibility at thumbnail size; Done when every still shows intended content, nothing overlaps, each headline readable in the thumbnail.

### Step 6: Full render and deliver — bash block verbatim (lines 207-211); Spot-check circle wipe and carousel slides with `ffmpeg -ss <t> -i <mp4> -frames:v 1 f.png`; Confirm ffprobe duration and nb_frames (frozen tail = timeline shorter than DURATION); Never overwrite an earlier version, bump vN; Report file path, beat-by-beat copy, every caveat (low-res sources, crops and mirrors, placeholders left, copy differing from landing page); Done when MP4 is in ~/Downloads/ with versioned name, ffprobe matches, caveats in message.

## Iterating on an earlier ad — Keep the workdir; Revise via CONFIG edit + re-render (swap hero pair or hook, change cta.button or proof.text), re-run Steps 5-6, deliver as vN+1; Copy the workdir per aspect ratio so 4:5 and 9:16 keep separate CONFIG.

## Gotchas — 11 rules: absolute timeline/frozen gap (re-time later at values, update window.DURATION, move `tl.to({}, { duration: 0.01 }, 15)`); wrong image path renders placeholder (setImg onerror), check contact sheet, prefer images.json names; fewer than ~12 gallery images repeat (7x7 grid modulo); --size alone cannot render 2x (CSS 1080x1350, deviceScaleFactor 1) -> template-map 2x master; too-long headline collides (phone top 392, carousel, end-card stack), trim copy, never shrink font below ~64px; tap + screenScroll one gesture, render a still at 1.64 (see conflicts) and check the dot sits on target; zsh aborts on unmatched glob: use `find . -maxdepth 1 -name 'still-*.jpg' -delete` not `rm still-*.jpg`; keep node_modules/ in scripts/, never copy scripts into workdir (Cannot find module 'playwright-core'); site images often small thumbnails: flag soft cards, offer higher-res originals in a/ under same filenames; no Google Chrome: run `npx playwright install chromium` in scripts/ once, pass `--channel chromium` to render.cjs and fetch-images.cjs.

## Reference files — references/template-map.md (render contract, CONFIG fields, DOM ids, CSS variables, per-ratio geometry, timeline map, cut/add recipes; read before editing); assets/template.html (copy to index.html, never edit in place); scripts/render.cjs flags --stills --out --size --fps --page --channel; scripts/fetch-images.cjs flags --url --out --min --limit --channel; scripts/contact-sheet.py (tiles images or stills into one labelled JPG).

## Attribution and license — Created by [danny.md](https://www.danny.md/skills/motion-ad), published under [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/): free to use and remix, not to sell; redistributed via github.com/fabricioctelles/skills with added metadata, portable path resolution, preflight check and references/template-map.md; this copy modified 2026-10 (ASD-STE100 rewrite of SKILL.md and references/template-map.md, pack consolidation; scripts/ and assets/ unchanged).
